purpose: Teach: あきらめる/リーズナブル/数時間/いえよ/一遍/しきりに/たいして/そのうえ

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんは難しい事もあきらめるなと教えて下さったぞ
lines.en: You know, Gran — when your father was young, he taught me never to give up on difficult things.
lines.style: Quiet, nostalgic opening. Gazes somewhere distant. Measured pace, deliberate. Pauses before the main memory, as if sorting through decades. Warm but contemplative.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、リーズナブルなお店で食事されたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes — and your father, he used to eat at those modest little restaurants, didn't he, dear?
lines.style: Warm, slightly amused. Gentle correction woven into agreement. Light, conversational lilt on the question. The tone of someone who was there, who remembers the small details.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが数時間も歩いてご家族の元に戻られたぞ
lines.en: Gran — he once walked for hours to get back to the family. That's who he was.
lines.style: Steady, remembering. Slight emphasis on the hours — it's the point. Quiet reverence underneath. Eyes are present even if looking at nothing. Not trying to convince, just telling.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、孫に「大事だっていえよ」と仰ってたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Oh, and didn't he always tell the grandchildren that what matters most is to say it out loud?
lines.style: Reflective, with a soft smile in the voice. The 'didn't he' carries gentle certainty. Slower pace, like savoring the memory. Tender without sentimentality.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんは一遍だけ仕事を辞めたぞ
lines.en: Gran — there was one time, just once, when he left his job. That was rare for him.
lines.style: Even quieter now. The weight of the exception. 'Just once' — emphasis on the rarity of it. Slower, more deliberate. Respect in the cadence.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、しきりに孫を可愛がられたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: He doted on the grandchildren though, didn't he? Constantly showing them affection.
lines.style: Warmer here, a small brightness breaking through. The word 'doted' carries affection. Matter-of-fact tone about his generosity. Rhythmic, like listing something well-known and loved.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、お父さんはたいして文句を言わない方だったぞ
lines.en: Gran — your father wasn't one to complain much. That was his way.
lines.style: Soft assertion. Not proud-sounding, just factual. Acceptance in the tone. Slight trailing-off, like there's more weight to that silence than words.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、お料理上手。そのうえ、お洗濯までされたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And he was such a good cook too, wasn't he? He'd even do the laundry. That man could do it all.
lines.style: Affectionate, slightly marveling. Gentle emphasis on 'do it all' — appreciation for his capability. The cadence of listing beloved qualities. Intimate, like sharing a private memory with someone who lived it too.
